contexts.achievement: Empty achievement conditions are explicitly excluded by check_achievements despite check_all([]) returning true.
contexts.dialogue: Node do actions run after its last line, before choices/branches/next; branch is first passing condition in source order, with an absent if acting as fallback. Choice do runs before its next.
contexts.gate: Empty block_if leaves the gate blocked (true); otherwise check_all decides blocked, so true means closed.
contexts.npc: First passing rule in source order chooses dialogue; absent if is eligible. exists_if empty does not remove NPC.
contexts.portal: Empty requires/conditions permits passage; portal arming/crossing remains separate from rule evaluation.
contexts.quest: advance_if can advance multiple consecutive active steps in a while loop; it does not advance beyond the last step.
contexts.trigger: Empty conditions permit trigger; once flag is set BEFORE its ordered actions.

diagnostics.message: Declared base action is emitted but preserved world._on_world_action has no matching branch; retain this legacy no-op until a separately reviewed change.

dispatch.actions: run_all executes synchronously left-to-right with no rollback; signals may synchronously change state and some extension handlers queue deferred work. Later actions observe earlier mutations; no implicit transaction or await is introduced.
dispatch.conditions: check_all uses ordered logical AND and stops at first false; an empty list returns true. check itself requires a nonempty operation array.
dispatch.extensionSelection: First Content.MODULES declaration containing ID wins; conditions return its result, actions call handler then report handled even when helper performs no action.
dispatch.fixedArityLegacy: Fixed handlers generally ignore unreferenced trailing arguments; the portable authoring validator rejects them and never silently changes saved/source data.
